versions.imageText:
David White
I have exciting news for all fitness enthusiasts and those looking to start their wellness journey.
I am thrilled to announce the opening of my new fitness studio,
Flex & Flow, located right in the heart of downtown Toronto! Our grand opening will be next Saturday, and we have an amazing lineup of activities to celebrate.
Take advantage of free workout classes, where you can participate in yoga, pilates, and strength training. Meet our special guest trainers and learn from the best in the business. You can also enjoy free nutritious snacks provided by local vendors.
Flex & Flow is all about creating a supportive community where you can achieve your fitness goals while having fun. Whether you're a seasoned athlete or just beginning, we have something for everyone. For more details and to RSVP, visit our website at www.flexandflow.ca.
versions.imageTextZh:
大卫·怀特
我有令人兴奋的消息，送给所有健身爱好者以及想开始健康之旅的人。
我高兴地宣布，我的新健身工作室
Flex & Flow 在多伦多市中心核心区开业！盛大开业定于下周六，我们准备了精彩活动阵容。
可参加免费健身课，包括瑜伽、普拉提与力量训练。与特邀教练见面，向业界佼佼者学习。也可享用本地商户提供的免费营养小食。
Flex & Flow 旨在打造支持性社区，让你在达成健身目标的同时享受乐趣。无论你是资深运动员还是刚起步，我们都有适合你的内容。更多详情与 RSVP，请访问 www.flexandflow.ca。

• Chat with wellness professionals who specialize in student health.
• Access free resources to support your mental and physical well-being.

To: Amy
From: David Chen
Title: University Administrator
Subject: Upcoming meeting
Hi Amy,
I'm afraid there has been another scheduling conflict. Conference
Room B is double booked on Friday morning. We can either meet on Friday afternoon or move to the smaller Conference Room A.
However, Conference Room A does not have a projector. I am not sure how you plan to present your ideas, so please let me know if this would be a problem.
As we discussed, the meeting will focus on potential updates for the campus Fall Festival. Please review the latest event schedule, which is attached to this email.
The university values student input when planning campus events, so we greatly appreciate your suggestions.
Thanks,
David Chen
University Administrator

Post by Laura Kim, Fitness Coach
Hey, everyone! I just wrapped up an incredible fitness boot camp in the beautiful city of Sydney, Australia. I wanted to share some highlights and tips from the camp with you all.
• Day 1: We started with an intense cardio session at Bondi Beach.
The fresh ocean air and stunning views made the workout feel energizing and refreshing.
• Day 2: Focused on strength training at a local gym. We used a variety of equipment, including dumbbells, resistance bands, and kettlebells.
• Day 3: Took a break from intense workouts and did a yoga session at a park overlooking the Sydney Opera House. The serene environment helped everyone relax and recharge.
• Day 4: Ended the camp with a group hike through the Blue Mountains.
It was challenging but absolutely worth it for the breathtaking scenery.
Throughout the boot camp, we emphasized the importance of proper nutrition and hydration. I shared tips on how to maintain a balanced diet and stay hydrated, especially during intense physical activities. I'm already looking forward to the next boot camp! If you have any questions about the workouts or want more fitness tips, feel free to ask in the comments below!

Greenfield's Dining Hall
Students can't stop talking about a new pasta dish that was introduced.
"It's addictive," said junior Carla Ruiz, who posted a photo on social media that quickly gained hundreds of likes.
"Once you taste it, you want more."
The chef refuses to reveal the secret ingredient, fueling speculation online. Some guess truffle oil; others say a rare, imported spice.
"I'll never tell," joked Chef Martin, smiling as students lined up for seconds.
The dish has its own hashtag: #MysteryPasta, which has already generated thousands of posts and memes. Dining services hinted at a recipe reveal during next month's food festival, keeping the campus buzzing with curiosity.
"It's become a game," said sophomore Liam Price. "Everyone wants to crack the code."
The mystery has turned an ordinary meal into a campus-wide obsession, proving that sometimes the smallest surprises create the biggest buzz.

CAMPUS NEWS
Time Capsule Unearthed
During Dorm Renovation
Construction crews renovating Murdoch Hall have discovered a time capsule buried by students in the year 1896, sparking excitement across campus.
Inside were letters, photographs, and a campus map showing buildings long gone. "It's like stepping into the past," said archivist Dana Wells, who catalogued the items. Students lined up to view the capsule's contents, marveling at the artifacts.
"Seeing their hopes and dreams-it's inspiring," said junior
Malik Johnson.
The university will host an exhibit next month featuring the capsule's contents alongside reflections from current students, some of whom have expressed interest in contributing to a new capsule, creating a bridge between the past and the present.
"It's a reminder of how much has changed-and how much hasn't," Wells added.
The discovery has sparked conversations about campus traditions and the importance of preserving history, turning a routine renovation into a moment of shared pride and curiosity.

内有信件、照片，以及标示早已消失建筑的校园地图。「就像走进过去，」整理这些物品的档案员达娜·韦尔斯说。学生排队观看胶囊内容，惊叹于这些文物。
「看到他们的希望与梦想——很鼓舞人，」大三学生

大学下月将举办展览，展出胶囊内容并搭配在校生感想；其中一些人表示有兴趣为新胶囊投稿，在过去与现在之间架起桥梁。
「这提醒我们变了多少——以及没变的有多少，」韦尔斯补充道。
这一发现引发关于校园传统与保存历史重要性的讨论，把例行翻新变成共同自豪与好奇的时刻。

versions.imageText:
AI-Generated Art on Campus
Visitors to the Petrunich Gallery can now view an exhibit of AI-generated paintings that blur the line between human creativity and machine learning.
One standout work, Dream Algorithm, depicts a city floating in a sea of binary code, while another, Echoes of Light, uses layered brushstrokes created by artificial neural networks to mimic sunrise over glass towers.
The exhibit, which was funded by an arts innovation grant, allows visitors to interact with a program that generates custom artwork in real time, allowing them to choose themes and color palettes. This feature has become the centerpiece of the show, enchanting everyone from art majors to computer science instructors.
"We're exploring the intersection of creativity and technology," said curator Dana Fields. "It challenges what art means."
"I made a painting with code-it felt empowering," said senior art major
Sofia Ramirez. "It's a new frontier."
versions.imageTextZh:
校园 AI 生成艺术
访客现可在彼得鲁尼奇画廊观看 AI 生成绘画展，作品模糊了人类创造力与机器学习的界限。
一件亮眼作品《梦算法》描绘漂浮在二进制之海中的城市；另一件《光的回响》用人工神经网络生成的层叠笔触模仿玻璃塔楼之上的日出。
该展由艺术创新基金资助，允许访客与可实时生成定制作品的程序互动，选择主题与色板。这一功能成为展览核心，让从艺术专业到计算机科学教师的所有人着迷。
「我们在探索创意与技术的交汇，」策展人达娜·菲尔兹说。「它挑战艺术的定义。」
「我用代码做了一幅画——感觉很有力量，」艺术专业大四生
索菲亚·拉米雷斯说。「这是新边疆。」

The exhibit, which was funded by an arts innovation grant, allows visitors to interact with a program that generates custom artwork in real time, allowing them to choose themes and color palettes. This feature has become the centerpiece of the show, enchanting everyone from art majors to computer science instructors.

"We're exploring the intersection of creativity and technology," said curator Dana Fields. "It challenges what art means." "I made a painting with code-it felt empowering," said senior art major Sofia Ramirez. "It's a new frontier."

versions.label: Wofo M12
versions.articleTitle: Award Winner Returns to Alma Mater
versions.imageText:
Award Winner Returns to Alma Mater By Kevin Martin
Students were stunned when actor Daniel Rivero, famous for his award-winning role in Horizon's Edge, visited
Ashburn College on Monday.
Rivero, a recent graduate of the Theater Arts program, returned to lead an impromptu drama workshop. Students crowded the theater hall, snapping selfies with the star and asking about his journey from Ashburn to Hollywood.
"I skipped lunch just to hear him," said sophomore
Lily Chen. Rivero shared stories from his early auditions, including moments of rejection that taught him resilience.
"Embrace failure-it's the doorway to invention," he told students. He also praised Ashburn's faculty for fostering his love of storytelling. "It feels like I never left," he added.
The visit sparked excitement across campus, with social media flooded by photos from the workshop. For many students, it was a reminder that big dreams can start in small classrooms.

获奖者重返母校 凯文·马丁报道
周一，因《地平线边缘》获奖角色成名的演员丹尼尔·里韦罗造访
阿什伯恩学院，令学生震惊。
里韦罗是戏剧艺术专业的新近毕业生，回来主持即兴戏剧工作坊。学生挤满剧场，与明星自拍，并询问他从阿什伯恩到好莱坞的历程。
「我连午饭都没吃就来听他讲，」大二学生
莉莉·陈说。里韦罗分享早期试镜故事，包括教会他韧性的拒绝时刻。
「拥抱失败——它是通向创造的门，」他告诉学生。他还称赞阿什伯恩教师培养了他对叙事的热爱。「感觉我从未离开，」他补充道。
这次访问让全校兴奋，社交媒体被工作坊照片淹没。对许多学生而言，它提醒人们：大梦想可以从小教室起步。

versions.directionText: Read an article in a student magazine.
versions.imageText:
Kintsugi, an ancient Japanese art, transforms broken pottery into objects of beauty by highlighting, not hiding, their cracks. Artisans use lacquer mixed with powdered gold, silver, or platinum to repair fractures, creating pieces that often become more valued than their original form.
Originating in the late fifteenth century, kintsugi reflects the philosophy of wabi-sabi, which honors imperfection and transience.
Its message extends beyond ceramics, inspiring personal growth and resilience by advising people to embrace flaws as part of life's narrative. Rather than viewing damage as failure, kintsugi reframes it as transformation, symbolizing strength, authenticity, and renewal in a perfection-driven world.
Today, workshops and studios worldwide teach both its technical craft and its profound philosophy, offering learners not only artistic skills but insights into acceptance, individuality, and creative expression. Kintsugi stands as a timeless reminder that beauty lies in uniqueness and in the stories our "cracks" reveal, an idea that applies to academic life and beyond.
versions.imageTextZh:
金缮是一种古老的日本艺术，通过凸显而非掩盖裂痕，把破碎陶器变为美的对象。工匠用混有金、银或铂金粉末的漆修复裂缝，制成的作品往往比原件更受珍视。
金缮起源于十五世纪末，体现了侘寂哲学——尊崇不完美与无常。
其启示超越陶瓷：鼓励人们把瑕疵当作生命叙事的一部分，从而启发个人成长与韧性。金缮不把损伤视为失败，而将其重构为转化，在追求完美的世界中象征力量、真实与更新。
今天，世界各地的工作坊与工作室既传授其技艺，也讲授其深刻哲学，让学习者不仅获得艺术技能，也领悟接纳、个性与创造性表达。金缮提醒我们：美在于独特，在于「裂缝」所讲述的故事——这一观念适用于学术生活乃至更广领域。

Kintsugi, an ancient Japanese art, transforms broken pottery into objects of beauty by highlighting, not hiding, their cracks. Artisans use lacquer mixed with powdered gold, silver, or platinum to repair fractures, creating pieces that often become more valued than their original form.

Originating in the late fifteenth century, kintsugi reflects the philosophy of wabi-sabi, which honors imperfection and transience. Its message extends beyond ceramics, inspiring personal growth and resilience by advising people to embrace flaws as part of life's narrative. Rather than viewing damage as failure, kintsugi reframes it as transformation, symbolizing strength, authenticity, and renewal in a perfection-driven world.

Today, workshops and studios worldwide teach both its technical craft and its profound philosophy, offering learners not only artistic skills but insights into acceptance, individuality, and creative expression. versions.imageTextZh:
金缮艺术哲学
金缮是一门古老的日本艺术，它通过强调而非掩盖裂纹，将破碎的陶器转化为美丽的艺术品。
工匠们使用混合了金粉、银粉或铂金粉的漆来修复裂痕，创造出通常比原物更具价值的作品。
金缮起源于十五世纪末，体现了推崇残缺与无常的“侘寂”哲学。
它的内涵超越了陶瓷本身，通过建议人们将缺陷视为生命叙事的一部分，来激发个人的成长与韧性。
金缮没有将破损视为失败，而是将其重新定义为一种转变，在一个追求完美的世界中象征着力量、真实与重生。
如今，世界各地的工坊和工作室都在教授其技术工艺和深刻哲理，不仅为学习者提供艺术技能，还提供对接纳、个性与创造性表达的深刻见解。
金缮作为一个永恒的提醒，告诉我们美存在于独特性以及我们的“裂痕”所展现的故事中，这一理念不仅适用于学术生活，也适用于更广泛的领域。

versions.label: Wofo M16
versions.directionText: Read an article in a student newspaper
versions.imageText:
Yesterday, the university flipped the switch on its new nuclear research reactor in the basement of the Franklin Applied Energy Lab, turning the engineering quad into the hottest spot on campus-literally and figuratively. The reactor, about the size of a classroom, won't charge cell phones or brew coffee; it's built for neutron experiments, advanced materials research, and isotope production. "The launch of this laboratory will provide unparalleled opportunities for the university," said Dr. Evelyn Pillai, project lead.
While some students have expressed safety concerns, a university spokesperson assured the community that the reactor is safer than the chemistry labs most first-year students wander into. "Radiation levels outside the facility are lower than what you'd get on a cross-country flight," said Dr. Pillai. Meanwhile, the Physics Club is planning a festive "Critical Mass Mixer" for Friday evening. The invitation features an atom whose colorful orbiting electrons are juggled by a mole.
versions.imageTextZh:
昨天，大学在富兰克林应用能源实验室地下室启动了新的核研究反应堆，把工程四方院变成校园最「热」的地方——字面与比喻皆然。该反应堆大约一间教室大小，不会给手机充电或煮咖啡；它为中子实验、先进材料研究与同位素生产而建。「这个实验室的启动将为大学提供无与伦比的机会，」项目负责人伊芙琳·皮莱博士说。
尽管一些学生表达安全关切，大学发言人向社区保证，该反应堆比多数一年级学生走进的化学实验室更安全。「设施外的辐射水平低于你跨大陆飞行所受到的，」皮莱博士说。与此同时，物理俱乐部计划周五晚举办喜庆的「临界质量酒会」。请柬上画着一个原子，彩色电子被一只鼹鼠抛接。

choices.explanationZh: 文章第一句就说 reactor 在 Franklin Applied Energy Lab，因此位于工程区附近这项为真。

choices.label: It is about the size of a classroom.

choices.explanationZh: 文中明确说它 about the size of a classroom，这项也为真。

choices.label: Its purpose is to provide power to the university.
choices.labelZh: 其目的是为大学提供电力。
choices.explanationZh: 文章特别说明 reactor 是用于 neutron experiments、materials research 和 isotope production，而不是 generating electricity，所以这项才是 EXCEPT。

choices.label: It has caused safety concerns amongst students.
choices.labelZh: 它引起了学生们的安全担忧。
choices.explanationZh: 原文提到 some students have expressed safety concerns，这项为真。

questions.promptText: What claim does the project lead make regarding the safety of the new reactor?
questions.promptTextZh: 项目负责人就新型反应堆的安全性提出了什么主张？

choices.label: It exposes passersby to less radiation than they would receive on an airplane.
choices.labelZh: 它使路人受到的辐射少于在飞机上受到的辐射。
choices.explanationZh: 项目负责人原话说设施外的辐射水平低于乘坐一次 cross-country flight 所受的辐射，这项是准确转述。

choices.label: It will provide opportunities for the university that override worries about safety.
choices.labelZh: 它将为大学提供超越安全担忧的发展机遇。
choices.explanationZh: 这是对项目价值的概括，不是她关于安全的直接说法。

choices.explanationZh: 这听起来合理，但 low-power、federal guidelines 这些措辞并不在原文里。

versions.label: Wofo M17
versions.imageText:
Discover Estonia's Timeless Charm
Nestled in northern Europe, Estonia blends cultural heritage with natural beauty, making it a captivating destination.
Its crown jewel, Tallinn's medieval Old Town-a UNESCO World Heritage site-invites visitors to wander cobblestone streets, admire historic buildings, and climb St. Olaf's Church for sweeping views.
Town Hall Square buzzes with markets, offering a glimpse of vibrant local life.
Just outside the capital, Lahema National Park showcases misty forests, tranquil bogs, and pristine coastlines. Adventurers can explore scenic trails and spot wildlife like moose and lynx.
Off the coast, Kihnu Island preserves age-old traditions, where locals wear folk attire and celebrate with music and festivals, offering an authentic cultural experience.
English is widely spoken, but learning a few Estonian phrases will enrich your journey. With its long daylight hours and mild weather, summer is the ideal season to explore Estonia's enchanting landscapes and living history.
versions.imageTextZh:
发现爱沙尼亚
永恒的魅力
坐落在北欧的爱沙尼亚融合文化遗产与自然之美，成为迷人的目的地。
其皇冠明珠塔林中世纪老城——联合国教科文组织
世界遗产——邀请访客漫步鹅卵石街道、欣赏历史建筑，并登上圣奥拉夫教堂俯瞰全景。
市政厅广场市集热闹，展现充满活力的本地生活。
首都郊外，拉赫马国家公园展示迷雾森林、静谧沼泽与原始海岸线。冒险者可探索风景步道，并发现麋鹿与猞猁等野生动物。
离岸的基赫努岛保存古老传统，当地人穿民俗服装并以音乐与节日庆祝，提供真实的文化体验。
英语广泛使用，但学几句爱沙尼亚语短语将丰富旅程。凭借漫长白昼与温和天气，夏季是探索爱沙尼亚迷人景观与活历史的理想季节。

choices.label: It features the largest central square in northern Europe.
choices.labelZh: 它拥有北欧最大的中央广场。
choices.explanationZh: 文中提到 Town Hall Square buzzes with markets，但没有说它是北欧最大的广场。

choices.labelZh: 它以艺术博物馆闻名。
choices.explanationZh: 宣传页没有把 art museums 说成 Tallinn Old Town 的核心卖点。

choices.labelZh: 这是一个当地人穿传统服饰的区域。
choices.explanationZh: 穿传统服饰的是 Kihnu Island 的 locals，不是 Tallinn Old Town 的主要吸引点。

versions.articleTitle: Travel Article - Discover Estonia's Timeless Charm
versions.imageText:
Nestled in northern Europe, Estonia blends cultural heritage with natural beauty, making it a captivating destination.

Its crown jewel, Tallinn's medieval Old Town—a UNESCO World Heritage site—invites visitors to wander cobblestone streets, admire historic buildings, and climb St. Olaf's Church for sweeping views.

Town Hall Square buzzes with markets, offering a glimpse of vibrant local life.

Just outside the capital, Lahemaa National Park showcases misty forests, tranquil bogs, and pristine coastlines. Adventurers can explore scenic trails and spot wildlife like moose and lynx.

Off the coast, Kihnu Island preserves age-old traditions, where locals wear folk attire and celebrate with music and festivals, offering an authentic cultural experience.

English is widely spoken, but learning a few Estonian phrases will enrich your journey.

With its long daylight hours and mild weather, summer is the ideal season to explore Estonia's enchanting landscapes and living history.
versions.imageTextZh:
坐落在北欧的爱沙尼亚将文化遗产与自然美景融为一体，使其成为一个迷人的目的地。
它的皇冠明珠——塔林中世纪老城（联合国教科文组织世界遗产地）——吸引着游客漫步在鹅卵石街道上，欣赏历史建筑，并攀登圣奥拉夫教堂以俯瞰全景。
市政厅广场集市熙熙攘攘，让人得以一窥充满活力的当地生活。
就在首都郊外，拉赫马国家公园展示了迷雾森林、宁静的沼泽和原始的海岸线。
冒险者可以探索风景优美的步道，并寻找驼鹿和猞猁等野生动物。
在海岸附近，基努岛保留了古老的传统，当地人穿着民族服饰，通过音乐和节日庆祝，提供地道的文化体验。
英语被广泛使用，但学习一些爱沙尼亚语短语将丰富你的旅程。
凭借漫长的日照时间和温和的天气，夏季是探索爱沙尼亚迷人风景和活生生的历史的理想季节。

From: martinez.isres@dmail.com

Dear Dr. Johnson,
As coordinator of the International Student Renewable Energy Symposium
(ISRES), I am pleased to invite you to be our keynote speaker at
Lisbon University on October 25.
Every year, ISRES brings students together from around the world to explore recent advances in renewable energy, facilitating the exchange of groundbreaking ideas via panel discussions, workshops, and networking sessions.
Given your reputation among solar technology researchers, your participation would enrich our conference immensely. This year's focus is photovoltaics.
We kindly request confirmation of your availability by September 15 to enable us to finalize the agenda and coordinate your travel itinerary. Your accommodation will be provided at the four-star Lisbon Grand Hotel, conveniently located downtown near the symposium venue and many restaurants.
We are looking forward to hearing from you. Should you have any questions, please contact me directly via email.
Warm regards,
Paul Martinez

versions.imageText:
Beginning next semester, residence-hall dining rooms will offer an enhanced selection of vegan menu options.
Some students choose veganism for ethical reasons, out of concern for the environment and for the treatment of animals. Raising animals for food contributes greatly to greenhouse gas emissions and is responsible for significant water pollution. Other students are motivated by health considerations, such as food allergies, or by respect for religious traditions.
Our creative dining hall chefs will incorporate many new recipes from around the world that will be irresistible even to carnivores! Aaron Larsen, who has been preparing meals at Carson Hall
Dining Room for eight years, says he has enjoyed learning new recipes and cooking techniques.
"At first I was skeptical about whether we could create truly satisfying dishes without using animal products, especially dairy foods," he said, "but now I'm very proud of what we are able to offer student diners."

自下学期起，宿舍餐厅将提供更丰富的纯素菜单选项。
一些学生因伦理原因选择纯素，出于对环境与动物待遇的关切。养殖食用动物大量贡献温室气体排放，并造成显著水污染。另一些学生则出于健康考虑（如食物过敏），或出于对宗教传统的尊重。
我们富有创意的餐厅主厨将纳入许多来自世界各地的新菜谱，连肉食者也会难以抗拒！在卡森堂餐厅做了八年饭的亚伦·拉森说，他很享受学习新菜谱与烹饪技巧。
「起初我怀疑我们能否在不用动物产品——尤其是乳制品——的情况下做出真正令人满意的菜，」他说，「但现在我为我们能提供给学生用餐者的食物感到非常自豪。」

Urgent: Campus Transport and Traffic Advisory
Beginning November 6, infrastructure improvements will take place on North Avenue. Work is scheduled from 7:00 A.M. to 7:00 P.M. daily, Mondays through Saturdays. Expect delays during the above hours, when North Avenue will be reduced to one lane in each direction. Students and staff are strongly encouraged to use alternative routes or the university’s expanded shuttle service.
Shuttle wait time will be decreased from 20 to 15 minutes at East Hall, West Commons, and Central Library.
Parking on North Avenue will be temporarily suspended starting on November 6. Overflow lots will be available at the Pemberton Parking Complex. Residents should expect increased noise and dust in the vicinity.
For updates, visit the university’s infrastructure website.

紧急：校园交通与路况提示
自 11 月 6 日起，北大道将进行基础设施改善。施工计划每天上午 7:00 至晚上 7:00，周一至周六。在上述时段北大道将双向各减为一条车道，请预期延误。强烈建议师生改用其他路线或大学扩展的班车服务。
东堂、西公共区与中央图书馆的班车候车时间将从 20 分钟减至 15 分钟。
自 11 月 6 日起北大道停车将临时暂停。彭伯顿停车综合楼提供溢出车位。住户应预期周边噪音与扬尘增加。
更新请访问大学基础设施网站。

Angela Kim (5:00 P.M.)
Hi everyone! Want to join me for a hike on Saturday at Green Valley with the Student Outdoors Club?
Tom Davies (5:05 P.M.)
What time?
Angela Kim (5:10 P.M.)
Let's meet at the trailhead at 8:00 A.M. Starting early will help us beat the heat, which starts creeping in at 9:00 A.M. Or so.
Sara Perez (5:15 P.M.)
What should we bring?
Angela Kim (5:20 P.M.)
Well, for sure, bring PLENTY of water.
Tom Davies (5:25 P.M.)
I'll bring extra water-good point about the heat! Do we need a permit?
I have heard that some hiking areas are now being protected.
Angela Kim (5:30 P.M.)
Let me check on that, Tom. Parking is limited-carpooling is best.
Milton Marks (5:35 P.M.)
I can drive! I've got room for three.
Tom Davies (5:40 P.M.)
I'll take that offer, Milton.
versions.imageTextZh:
安吉拉·金（下午 5:00）
大家好！周六想和我一起参加学生户外俱乐部在绿谷的徒步吗？
汤姆·戴维斯（下午 5:05）
几点？
安吉拉·金（下午 5:10）
我们在登山口上午 8:00 集合。早点出发有助于避开热浪，热气大约上午 9:00 开始上来。
萨拉·佩雷斯（下午 5:15）
我们该带什么？
安吉拉·金（下午 5:20）
务必带上足够的水。

我会多带水——关于热的提醒很对！需要许可证吗？
我听说有些徒步区现在受保护。

汤姆，我查一下。停车位有限——最好拼车。

我可以开车！还能坐三个人。
汤姆·戴维斯（下午 5:40）
米尔顿，我接受你的邀请。

choices.label: The trail will eventually climb to an extremely high altitude.
choices.labelZh: 小径最终会攀升到极高的海拔。
choices.explanationZh: 群聊没提海拔很高。

choices.label: The conditions along the trail will be exceptionally windy and dusty.
choices.labelZh: 小径沿途的条件会异常多风且多尘。
choices.explanationZh: 群聊没提风沙。

choices.label: The water for sale along the trail is too expensive.
choices.labelZh: 小径沿途出售的水太贵了。
choices.explanationZh: 群聊没提沿途水太贵。

choices.label: The temperature along the trail will start to climb after about nine a.m.
choices.labelZh: 小径沿途的温度大约在上午九点后开始上升。
choices.explanationZh: 正确：Angela 说 "Starting early will help us beat the heat, which starts creeping in at 9 a.m."，所以要带很多水是因为 9 点后开始热。

questions.promptTextZh: 下午5:30，安吉拉写道“让我确认一下，汤姆”时，她暗示了什么？

choices.label: She knows that the hiking trails in Green Valley are not protected.
choices.labelZh: 她知道绿谷的徒步小径未受保护。
choices.explanationZh: Angela 说要去查，正说明她不知道 trail 是否被保护。

choices.label: She is concerned about the difficulty of the trail at Green Valley.
choices.labelZh: 她担心绿谷小径的难度。
choices.explanationZh: 群聊没说她担心 trail 难度。

choices.labelZh: 她不确定徒步该小径是否需要许可证。
choices.explanationZh: 正确：Tom 问 "Do we need a permit?"，Angela 回 "Let me check on that"，意为她不确定，要去查。

choices.explanationZh: 她说的是 parking 有限，没有说 parking 不需要 permit。

Student Housing
Four Simple Ways to Reduce Plastic Waste on Campus
Hey students!
Today, we are sharing four practical tips for reducing plastic waste in your everyday life. These small changes can make a big difference for our planet.
1. Bring Your Own Bags: Always carry reusable bags when you go shopping. Avoid single-use plastic bags that can end up in landfills and oceans.
2. Use Refillable Water Bottles: Ditch the disposable plastic bottles and invest in a durable, refillable water bottle. This reduces plastic waste AND saves you money.
3. Say No to Plastic Straws: Opt for reusable metal or bamboo straws. Many cafés and restaurants now provide eco-friendly alternatives.
4. Choose Products with Less Packaging: Look for brands that use minimal or eco-friendly packaging. This can greatly reduce the amount of waste you generate.
Share your plastic-reduction tips in the comments below!
#StudentHousing #GreenTips

学生住宿
在校园减少塑料垃圾的四个简单方法
同学们好！
今天我们分享四条在日常生活中减少塑料垃圾的实用提示。这些小改变能为地球带来大影响。
1. 自备袋子：购物时总是携带可重复使用的袋子。避免最终进入垃圾填埋场与海洋的一次性塑料袋。
2. 使用可再充水瓶：丢掉一次性塑料瓶，投资耐用、可再充的水瓶。这既减少塑料垃圾又省钱。
3. 拒绝塑料吸管：选择可重复使用的金属或竹吸管。许多咖啡馆与餐厅现提供环保替代品。
4. 选择包装更少的产品：寻找使用最少或环保包装的品牌。这可大幅减少你产生的垃圾。
在评论区分享你的减塑提示！
#StudentHousing #GreenTips

versions.label: Wofo M25
versions.imageText:
CAMPUS RESEARCHERS "CRACK" THE CONCRETE CODE
Researchers at the university have developed an affordable self-healing concrete. When cracks form, embedded microcapsules release a gap-sealing mineral solution.
The prototype has already survived 50 freeze-thaw cycles in the lab, and now real-world testing is beginning on campus walkways, although students and faculty probably will not notice anything unusual beneath their feet.
Researchers predict huge benefits. "Our goal is to reduce costly repairs and extend building lifespans," said lead researcher
Dr. Elena Vargas. "Imagine bridges that fix themselves after storms."
Civil engineering professor Mark Chen called the innovation both practical and environmentally responsible. "This could revolutionize construction," he said. "By minimizing waste and extending the life of materials, we're saving money and reducing the environmental footprint."
Larger trials are in the works, but for now campus walkways are a living laboratory, offering a glimpse into a future where concrete is resilient enough to heal itself.
versions.imageTextZh:
校园研究者「破解」混凝土密码
大学研究者开发出可负担的自愈混凝土。裂缝形成时，内嵌微胶囊释放填缝矿物溶液。
原型已在实验室经受 50 次冻融循环，现开始在校园步道进行真实测试，尽管师生大概不会注意到脚下有何异常。
研究者预期巨大收益。「我们的目标是减少昂贵维修并延长建筑寿命，」首席研究员埃莱娜·巴尔加斯博士说。「想象风暴后自行修复的桥梁。」
土木工程教授马克·陈称这一创新既实用又对环境负责。「这可能彻底改变建筑业，」他说。「通过减少浪费并延长材料寿命，我们既省钱又降低环境足迹。」
更大规模试验在筹备中，而目前校园步道是活实验室，一窥混凝土足以自我愈合的未来。

Hey Eli. I'm having a problem with my mini fridge. I hear the motor humming, but it's not cooling off. David from our history class tells me you're good at fixing things like this.
Could you come by and have a look?

Hey Elena. I'd be happy to take a look. Right now I'm in the library with my math study group. We just got here.
Elena Rowe (4:46 P.M.)
Oh, I didn't mean right away. Any time is good.

How about tomorrow at 12:30?

versions.label: Wofo M28
versions.imageText:
The Artisan's Palette
Playing now as part of the university's international film festival,
The Artisan's Palette offers a contemplative alternative to blockbuster spectacle.
Set in Montclair, France—a beautiful village marked by economic decline-the film follows Elise Dupont, a painter confronting creative stagnation. Her struggle intensifies with the arrival of Marc, a self-described photographer whose shadowy motives become apparent even as he strives to earn Elise's trust.
Themes of authenticity and deception permeate the narrative, underscored by striking cinematography that contrasts the vivid colors of Elise's canvases with the muted tones of her daily life.
While deliberate pacing and occasional narrative drift may challenge viewers accustomed to rapid action, the film excels in character depth.
Isabelle Laurent delivers a nuanced portrayal of Elise, balancing vulnerability and resolve, while Jean-Pierre Lemoine's enigmatic
Marc sustains tension throughout. For audiences drawn to character-driven storytelling and visual artistry, this work offers a richly textured exploration of ambition and identity.
versions.imageTextZh:
《匠人之调色板》
作为大学国际电影节的一部分正在放映，
《匠人之调色板》提供有别于大片奇观的沉思选择。
故事设定在法国蒙特克莱尔——一座因经济衰退而留下印记的美丽村庄——跟随画家埃莉丝·杜邦面对创作停滞。随着自称为摄影师、动机暧昧的马克到来，她的挣扎加剧；即便他努力赢得埃莉丝信任，其阴影动机也逐渐显露。
真实性与欺骗的主题贯穿叙事，精美摄影对比埃莉丝画布上的鲜艳色彩与日常生活的灰暗色调。
虽从容节奏与偶发的叙事游移可能挑战习惯快节奏动作的观众，本片在人物深度上出色。
伊莎贝尔·洛朗对埃莉丝的刻画细腻，平衡脆弱与坚定；让-皮埃尔·勒穆瓦纳谜一般的马克则始终维持张力。对喜爱人物驱动叙事与视觉艺术性的观众，这部作品对野心与身份的探索层次丰富。

Oceantide University has launched an exciting new makerspace this semester, providing students with cutting-edge tools such as 3D printers, laser cutters, and advanced design software.
While the space is housed in the engineering building, it is open to all majors, encouraging collaboration and creativity across disciplines. "Our goal is to empower students to turn ideas into tangible solutions," said makerspace manager Diego Ramirez. To help students get started, the makerspace offers free workshops on prototyping, product design, and hands-on fabrication techniques. Knowledgeable staff members are available to provide technical support and guidance to users.
Funded through a generous grant from a local tech company, the makerspace aims to spark innovation and entrepreneurship on campus. Early projects have included custom phone cases, detailed architectural models, and robotics prototypes.
Students are already sharing their creations on social media, showcasing the makerspace as a hub for ingenuity and practical learning.

versions.label: Wofo M30
versions.imageText:
Blackout Brings Creativity to Finals Week
A sudden power outage during finals week left Smithfield students scrambling for solutions. Students took advantage of their smart-phone flashlights, and university staff provided camping lights for dorm lounges.
"It was stressful but kind of fun," said sophomore Grace Lee.
The blackout lasted six hours, caused by a transformer failure near campus. Dining services offered free coffee, and professors extended deadlines to ease the pressure.
"We made the best of it," said senior Omar Davis, who studied with his bike light. Social media buzzed with photos of candlelit study sessions, turning the inconvenience into a moment of campus unity.
Some students even organized impromptu acoustic concerts on the quad, proving that creativity thrives under constraints.
"It reminded us that community matters more than convenience," said Professor Laura Chen. By the early morning hours, power was restored, but the evening's events left a lasting impression.
versions.imageTextZh:
停电给期末周带来创意
期末周期间突然停电，让史密斯菲尔德的学生急寻对策。学生用智能手机手电筒，大学工作人员为宿舍休息室提供露营灯。
「压力大，但挺有趣，」大二学生格蕾丝·李说。
停电持续六小时，由校园附近变压器故障引起。餐饮服务提供免费咖啡，教授延长截止日期以缓解压力。
「我们尽力而为，」用自行车灯学习的大四生奥马尔·戴维斯说。社交媒体上烛光学习的照片刷屏，把不便变成校园团结时刻。
一些学生甚至在四方院组织即兴原声音乐会，证明约束中创意仍旺盛。
「这提醒我们，社区比便利更重要，」劳拉·陈教授说。清晨电力恢复，但当晚的事留下持久印象。

versions.label: Wofo M30
versions.imageText:
DORM STARTUP GOES VIRAL
Two computer science majors, Priya Singh and Marco Alvarez, transformed a late-night coding session into a nationwide sensation.
Their app, PlanForge, designed to help students organize assignments and track deadlines, was launched from their dorm room at the end of the semester.
"We built it to survive finals," Priya laughed. Within a week, downloads skyrocketed past 10,000, and alumni investors began reaching out. The duo has been invited to present at a major tech conference.
"It's surreal," Marco said. "We never imagined this level of attention."
Students are thrilled. "It's a lifesaver—I finally feel on top of my work," said sophomore Jenna Brooks.
The university's entrepreneurship center has offered mentorship to the two computer science majors. Professors have called the innovation a perfect example of student creativity.
Priya and Marco hope to expand the app's features to include group-project tools and reminders, proving big ideas can start in small dorm rooms.

两名计算机科学专业学生普里娅·辛格与马可·阿尔瓦雷斯，把深夜编程变成全国轰动。
他们的应用 PlanForge 旨在帮助学生组织作业并跟踪截止日期，在学期末从宿舍房间上线。

「不真实，」马可说。「我们从没想象过这种关注。」
学生很兴奋。「救星——我终于觉得能掌控功课，」大二生詹娜·布鲁克斯说。
大学创业中心已为这两名计算机科学专业学生提供指导。教授称这一创新是学生创意的完美例证。

Please consider registering for the newly developed Creative
Writing Seminar, designed to help you enhance your writing skills and unleash your creativity. Led by professors from our Creative

Route To Institute

Ana DeOliveira (2:30 P.M.)

Hi, everyone. My art history class is meeting at the Nolan Fine Arts Institute downtown tomorrow at 10:00 A.M. I had to leave class early and missed what the professor said about getting there. Any thoughts on the best route from campus?

Luis Martinez (2:33 P.M.)

Well, Bus 45 is direct, but it takes forever in morning traffic. Maybe try the subway if you are concerned about getting to the institute on time.

Sofia Holmes (2:34 P.M.)

The subway is faster for sure, but you have to walk about fifteen minutes from the station to the museum district.

Ana DeOliveira (2:35 P.M.)

Oh, wow. I will be carrying lots of heavy books.

Sofia Holmes (2:36 P.M.)

I think you can cut through the park. There are benches where you can rest for a bit. Still faster than bus overall, I think.

Ana DeOliveira (2:37 P.M.)

Thanks! I will give the subway a try. The professor is a stickler about being late for class. I know I will use those park benches!

Celebrate global culture at the Campus International Festival!
Over the course of two days this spring, students, faculty, staff, and local community members will gather on the university quad to present traditions from over 20 countries through music, food, and art.
• Performances will include African drumming and Celtic harp.
• Cooking demonstrations will teach the preparation of authentic dishes ranging from Italian pasta to Japanese sushi.
• Storytelling sessions will showcase folkloric traditions from multiple regions.
• The Global Market will feature handmade crafts and textiles.
• Workshops will invite attendees to try cultural dances, explore calligraphy, and communicate in new languages.
• Student groups will also host panels on diversity and inclusion, encouraging cross-campus dialogue.
• Families are welcome: The Children's Corner will offer creative art projects and storytelling.
Ticket proceeds will support student-led community-building initiatives, reinforcing the festival's mission to celebrate diversity and unity while strengthening ties between the campus and its host community.

versions.imageText:
Frankson Library Renovation and Temporary Relocation
Attention University Community:
Beginning October 10, the Frankson Library will undergo a major renovation to enhance study spaces and technological resources. The project is scheduled to continue through March 15.
During this period, the library's operational services will be temporarily relocated to the second and third floors of the Meyer Student Union Building. The temporary library spaces will operate weekdays from 8:00 A.M. to 10:00 P.M. and on weekends from 10:00 A.M. to 6:00 P.M.
Library administrative offices will be temporarily relocated to the university's Main Building.
Extra shuttle buses will run between the Main Quad and the Meyer Student Union Building to accommodate increased traffic. Students are encouraged to explore our expanded digital resources available through the university's online portal.
We appreciate your patience as we improve our facilities.
For updates, visit the library's webpage or contact library@university.edu.

versions.imageText:
Student Housing Dilemma: A Shortage of Affordable Options
As the new academic year kicks off at Bridgeford University, students face significant challenges in finding places to live. Reports indicate a significant shortage of affordable on-campus accommodation, pushing many to seek alternatives in the already competitive off-campus market. Sarah Lee, a sophomore, notes, “Last year, I secured on-campus housing easily, but this time I had to move two miles away, turning a five-minute walk into a fifteen-minute drive.”
According to the university's Housing Department, this shortage is due to increased enrollment and delayed construction of new dormitories. The Student Union has stepped in, advocating for more immediate solutions like temporary housing subsidies and partnerships with local landlords. Additionally, the Union is organizing workshops on tenant rights and apartment-hunting strategies.
Campus officials assure students that efforts are underway to accelerate dormitory construction, aiming for completion by next fall. Housing affordability is an issue that demands long-term solutions as university enrollment keeps rising.
versions.imageTextZh:
学生住房困境：可负担选项短缺
布里奇福德大学新学年开始，学生在找住处面临重大挑战。报告显示可负担的校内住宿严重短缺，迫使许多人转向本已竞争激烈的校外市场。大二学生萨拉·李说：「去年我轻松拿到校内住房，这次却得搬到两英里外，把五分钟步行变成十五分钟车程。」
据大学住房部门，短缺源于入学增加与新宿舍建设延迟。学生会已介入，倡导临时住房补贴、与本地房东合作等更即时方案。此外，学生会正组织关于租客权利与找房策略的工作坊。
校方保证正在加快宿舍建设，目标明年秋天完工。随着入学持续上升，住房可负担性是需要长期方案的问题。

versions.label: Wofo M39
versions.imageText: At noon yesterday, Summit View University's quad suddenly erupted into music as fifty dance majors performed a surprise choreographed routine to celebrate Arts Week. “We wanted to bring joy and energy,” said organizer Leah Ogorzelec, who spent two weeks planning the event in secret. “By all accounts, we succeeded!” Students gathered in droves, cheering and filming the spectacle. “It made my day,” said freshman Ryan Patel, who shared the video on social media. Within hours, clips of the flash mob were trending, earning thousands of likes and comments. The performance ended with a dramatic group pose and applause echoing across campus. “It's all about making art accessible to everyone,” Ms. Ogorzelec explained. Faculty praised the creativity of the event, calling it a perfect kickoff to Arts Week. The event has sparked conversations about adding more spontaneous art experiences to campus life, proving that a little rhythm can unite an entire community.

versions.label: Wofo M40
versions.imageText:
Global Culinary Institute — Spring 2024
CULN 310 Advanced Techniques: Sous Vide
Course Description: This course explores the sous vide culinary method, a meticulous process in which vacuum-sealed pouches are placed in a water bath at a precisely controlled temperature. Students who successfully complete the course will be able to harness their knowledge of the biochemical interactions and thermal dynamics that underly the sous vide technique to achieve optimal flavor profiles and textural nuances. Successful students will also be able to demonstrate their understanding of the historical progression and contemporary adaptations of sous vide technology, engage with state-of-the-art sous vide equipment, and critically evaluate the applications of the sous vide technique in haute cuisine.
Prerequisites: CULN 110 (Foundational Culinary Arts) and CULN 153 (Introduction to Gastronomic Science). Enrollment is limited to Culinary Arts advanced track students.
Department: Culinary Arts
Schedule: MWF 2–5 P.M. Credits: Three (3)
Instructor: Marie Dubois, Certified Master Chef

全球烹饪学院 — 2024 春季

课程描述：本课探索真空低温烹调方法——将真空密封袋置于精确控温水浴中的细致过程。成功完成课程的学生将能运用对真空低温技巧背后生化相互作用与热动力学的知识，实现最佳风味轮廓与质地细微差别。成功的学生也将能展示对真空低温技术历史演进与当代改编的理解，操作最先进的真空低温设备，并批判性评估该技巧在高级料理中的应用。
先修：CULN 110（烹饪艺术基础）与 CULN 153（美食科学导论）。仅限烹饪艺术进阶轨道学生注册。
系别：烹饪艺术
时间：周一三五 下午 2–5 学分：三（3）
教师：认证主厨玛丽·杜波依斯

versions.imageText:
NEXT SEMESTER, THE CAMPUS FITNESS CENTER WILL OFFER A SERIES OF RECREATIONAL CLASSES IN IYENGAR YOGA.
Iyengar yoga is distinct from other forms of yoga familiar to many people. Various forms of vinyasa—“flow yoga”—are popular today. If you have taken yoga classes, you have probably experienced this approach, which involves moving from pose to pose with minimal pauses. Iyengar yoga takes a more deliberate approach: Teachers demonstrate poses, emphasizing alignment and precision, and then instruct students with clear, specific language.
Developed by B.K.S. Iyengar (1918–2014), Iyengar Yoga is grounded in the ancient Indian tradition and philosophy of Patanjali’s Yoga-sutras. A master teacher himself, Iyengar became a highly influential teacher of teachers, creating a rigorous system of training and certification. Iyengar teachers are skilled in helping students develop strength, flexibility, and concentration. Their approach provides a safe way to learn yoga poses and accommodates students with physical limitations.
Introduction to Iyengar Yoga: Tues/Thurs 5:00 P.M.–6:30 P.M.

下学期，校园健身中心将开设系列艾扬格瑜伽休闲课程。
艾扬格瑜伽有别于许多人熟悉的其他瑜伽形式。今天流行的各种流瑜伽（vinyasa）——「流动瑜伽」——若你上过瑜伽课，大概经历过这种方式：从姿势到姿势移动、几乎不停顿。艾扬格瑜伽采取更从容的路径：教师演示姿势，强调对齐与精确，再用清晰、具体的语言指导学生。
由 B.K.S. 艾扬格（1918–2014）发展，艾扬格瑜伽植根于帕坦伽利《瑜伽经》的古印度传统与哲学。艾扬格本人是大师级教师，也成为极具影响力的教师之师，创立严格的培训与认证体系。艾扬格教师善于帮助学生发展力量、柔韧与专注。其方法为学习瑜伽姿势提供安全途径，并容纳有身体限制的学生。

The Rise of Sustainable Living in University Housing
Martinsburg (April 10)
As universities trend toward eco-consciousness, more students are embracing sustainable living in campus housing. At Greenleaf University, the new EcoHousing initiative features solar panels and rainwater-harvesting systems. Select dorms also have communal gardens. This program aligns with students' growing demand for environmentally friendly spaces. In a recent survey, 78 percent of Greenleaf students expressed interest in sustainable housing. The initiative also includes workshops on recycling and energy conservation, aiming to create environmentally aware graduates. Emily Hart, a senior in environmental science, noted, “Living sustainably on campus shows that daily choices have global impact.” The administration hopes this program will inspire other schools to follow suit. Greenleaf even offers financial incentives: Students who choose EcoHousing receive a 5 percent discount on housing fees. The university plans to expand the initiative to more dorms next year.

versions.imageText:
BOOSTING CAMPUS LIFE: NEW INITIATIVES FOR STUDENT ENGAGEMENT
Elmbrook College has launched several initiatives to enhance student engagement this fall. The Campus Connections program now offers over 100 clubs and organizations, ranging from environmental activism to tech innovation. Students can explore diverse interests and build communities around shared passions.
The revamped student-housing system features themed residence halls, including Sustainability House and Global Cultures House, designed to foster deeper connections among residents with similar values. These learning communities encourage collaboration beyond the classroom.
The Career Center has partnered with local businesses to create 300 part-time job opportunities for students. Additionally, the Volunteer Hub platform matches students with community-service projects aligned with their interests and academic goals.
"These programs will significantly enrich campus life and support our students' personal and professional growth," said College President Dr. Emily Caldwell. The initiatives aim to prepare students for success during and after graduation.

Harrison University recently launched a bike-sharing program to promote sustainable transportation and reduce parking congestion. Students can now rent bikes from racks located near residence halls, academic buildings, and the student center. The program offers free rentals for an hour and charges a small fee afterward, making it affordable for short trips across campus.
Each bike is equipped with a GPS tracker to ensure security and ease of locating. "This is about giving students greener options," said transportation coordinator Alex Nguyen. "We sent out a survey last semester, and students were overwhelmingly in favor of the program. They see it as making a difference environmentally."
The initiative was funded through a partnership with Benny's Cyclery, which sells the bikes at a discount and provides maintenance. Early feedback has been positive, with students praising the convenience and environmental benefits. The university plans to expand the program next semester by adding electric bikes.

versions.label: Wofo M45
versions.imageText:
Zoning Policy Beyond the Classroom
Dr. Paredes' hybrid Zoning Policy Field Methods course bridges the gap between academic theory and the real world. The seminar alternates between campus and town locations: On-campus discussions focus on theory and research, while in town, students interact with community members in the café of a neighborhood grocery store and also browse the municipal archives. Students' campus-based assumptions are often challenged when residents describe the effects of zoning changes.
This approach connects theoretical perspectives to lived experiences, but creates logistical uncertainty. Because residents' schedules can shift, planned group meetings are sometimes adjusted, and revised details may arrive late, frustrating students who prefer predictable routines.
One course highlight makes this unpredictability worthwhile: Group interviews with residents vividly reveal how zoning policies affect everyday people, as when removing commercial use permission leads to store closures. Students willing to stay flexible will gain valuable insight into how theory plays out in real life.
versions.imageTextZh:
走出课堂的分区政策
Paredes博士开设的混合式“分区政策实地方法”课程，将学术理论与现实世界连接起来。研讨课在校园和城镇地点之间交替进行：校园内的讨论聚焦于理论和研究；在城镇中，学生在社区杂货店的咖啡馆与社区成员交流，并查阅市政档案。当居民描述分区变更的影响时，学生基于校园形成的假设常常会受到挑战。
这种方法将理论观点与生活经验联系起来，但也带来了日程安排上的不确定性。由于居民的日程可能发生变化，原定的小组会议有时会被调整，修改后的细节也可能很晚才公布，这会让偏好可预测日程的学生感到沮丧。
课程的一大亮点使这种不可预测性变得值得：与居民进行的小组访谈生动地揭示了分区政策如何影响普通人的生活，例如取消商业用途许可会导致商店关闭。愿意保持灵活的学生将深入了解理论如何在现实生活中发挥作用。

questions.promptText: What is the main purpose of the article?
questions.promptTextZh: 这篇文章的主要目的是什么？

choices.label: To examine how alternating between classroom and community enriches students' understanding of course material

versions.imageText:
ANTH 214:
Instructor: Dr. Khatri
Office hours: by appointment (in person or video)
Course focus: Students practice interviewing, observation, and ethical documentation while partnering with the Campus Food Pantry to improve volunteer training.

Grading (percentage of final grade):
• Participation and lab notes: 30%
• Midterm (research design review): 30%
• Research proposal: 10%
• Final project-portfolio (including interview transcript excerpts): 30%

Key policies:
• Attendance: Because peer feedback is critical to each session, more than two absences may reduce the final grade.
• Recordings: Audio capture is permitted only after written consent. Store files in the course folder, not on personal devices.
• AI tools: Drafting is allowed for brainstorming, but students must disclose use in an appendix and verify quotations.

Materials: A notebook, headphones, and access to the library database are required.

ANTH 214：
授课教师：Khatri博士
办公时间：预约（可面谈或视频会面）
课程重点：学生将练习访谈、观察和合乎伦理的记录，同时与校园食品储藏室合作，改进志愿者培训。

versions.imageText:
Subject:
Request for career guidance meeting

Dear Dr. Patel,

I am exploring graduate programs in public health and would value your advice regarding which ones are the most "up-and-coming" and which are the most well-regarded. I am only a freshman, so is it too early to start thinking about graduate school? I would also value your perspective on which internships to pursue and what extracurricular activities to participate in.

I would also like to discuss internship opportunities at the Edgefield Health Department, since I'm interested in epidemiology.

I've reviewed your recent publication on community health interventions and hope to learn how those strategies apply to graduate research.

Could we meet next Tuesday at 3 P.M. in your office? If that time doesn't work, I'm available Thursday morning between 9 and 11 A.M. Please let me know which time works best.

Thank you for your time.

Sincerely,
Maria Chen

versions.label: Wofo M47
versions.articleTitle: The campus café launched two AI-powered robot baristas this week
versions.imageText:
The campus café launched two AI-powered robot baristas this week, aiming to reduce wait times during peak hours. Each robot can brew 50 drinks per hour and accepts mobile payments only. The $100,000 investment was funded by a tech grant. Students can customize drinks via an app, which even allows them to choose latte art generated by algorithms.

The robots are stationed in two high-traffic spots: one inside the main student center and the other in the engineering building’s atrium. These locations were chosen to serve both social spaces and academic hubs where coffee demand is highest.

“We’re blending convenience with innovation,” said campus café manager Jordan Lee.

“It’s about creating a futuristic experience.” “I ordered a cappuccino, and the foam had a smiley face,” said junior Maya Patel. “It’s weird but fun.”

On launch day, a small group of students protested the replacement of student workers with robots.
versions.imageTextZh:
校园咖啡馆本周上线了两台人工智能机器人咖啡师，目的是缩短高峰时段的等候时间。每台机器人每小时可制作 50 杯饮品，且只接受移动支付。这项 10 万美元的投入由一笔科技拨款资助。学生可以通过应用程序定制饮品，甚至还能选择算法生成的拿铁拉花。

机器人被放在两处人流密集的位置：一台在主学生中心内，另一台在工程楼中庭。选择这两个地点，是为了同时服务社交空间和咖啡需求最高的学术区域。

校园咖啡馆经理 Jordan Lee 说：“我们把便利和创新结合在一起。”

“这是为了创造一种未来感体验。”“我点了一杯卡布奇诺，泡沫上有一张笑脸，”大三学生 Maya Patel 说。“有点怪，但很有趣。”

上线当天，一小群学生抗议用机器人取代学生工。

During the week of December 28–January 3, the swimming pool at Wilson Gym will be closed for maintenance.

While the pool closes annually for a week of maintenance, this year's closure will bring a significant change: a transition from the current chlorinated sanitation system to a saltwater-based system. Saltwater systems generate chlorine naturally from dissolved salt, creating a more comfortable swimming experience. Many swimmers find the water less irritating to their skin, eyes, and hair because the chlorine levels stay more consistent. Saltwater systems also eliminate the strong chemical smell associated with manually added chlorine.

The closure is timed to occur during winter break when many students are away. However, those remaining on campus who wish to swim during that week will have access to the pool at the YWCA on Biltmore St.

To use that pool, simply show your student ID at the front desk.

GHOSTLY WHISPERS IN LIBRARY
Greenfield University's historic library has become the center of spooky rumors after students reported whispers and flickering lights during late-night study sessions. "I swear I saw a ghostly figure," said senior Emma Li, who shared her experience on social media.
The mystery began when renovations uncovered a reading room that had been sealed since 1904. Paranormal clubs are planning a midnight investigation with cameras and audio recorders, while campus security insists the disturbances are due to "old wiring and drafts."
Still, the story has sparked excitement across campus. "It's creepy but funny," said freshman Noah Grant, who plans to livestream the ghost hunt. The library staff has embraced the buzz, adding a "Haunted History" display near the entrance featuring old photographs and letters.
Whether it's a ghost or just campus folklore, the rumors have turned the library into the most talked-about spot on campus this semester.

versions.label: Koala 07-08
versions.imageText:
Survey of Literary Theory

This course offers advanced undergraduates an introduction to major schools of literary theory and criticism, providing students with the tools to analyze texts from multiple perspectives and compare the resulting theoretical analyses. Beginning with foundational approaches such as formalism and structuralism, the course explores key movements including Marxist, feminist, psychoanalytic, postcolonial, and reader-response theories. Readings will include works by theorists such as Ferdinand de Saussure, Roland Barthes, and Judith Butler. Students will examine how various frameworks shape interpretation, influence cultural discourse, and challenge traditional notions of meaning and authorship. Through close reading and critical discussion, participants will learn to apply theoretical concepts to diverse literary works, enhancing their ability to engage with texts in nuanced and informed ways. By the end of the course, students will develop a deeper understanding of the role theory plays in literary studies and acquire essential skills for advanced analysis and scholarly writing.
versions.imageTextZh:
文学理论概论
本课程向高年级本科生介绍主要的文学理论和批评流派，为学生提供从多个视角分析文本并比较所得理论分析结果的工具。
从形式主义和结构主义等基础方法开始，本课程探讨了包括马克思主义、女权主义、精神分析、后殖民主义和读者反应理论在内的主要运动。
阅读材料将包括费迪南·德·索绪尔、罗兰·巴特和朱迪斯·巴特勒等理论家的作品。
学生将考察各种理论框架如何塑造诠释、影响文化话语，并挑战关于意义和作者身份的传统观念。
通过细读和批判性讨论，参与者将学习如何将理论概念应用于不同的文学作品，从而提高他们以细致且有见地的方式解读文本的能力。
到课程结束时，学生将对理论在文学研究中所起的作用有更深入的理解，并获得进行高级分析和学术写作的基本技能。

Dear Professor Stoll,

I am seeking a sponsor for an independent study next semester. I propose to read three of George Eliot's novels and write a paper focusing on Eliot's treatment of social class.

I became intrigued by Eliot when I read her novel Middlemarch in your Victorian Literature course and wanted to explore Eliot's work further. Since no courses offered this year include her novels, I can only pursue this project as an independent study.

The novels I propose to read are Adam Bede, The Mill on the Floss, and Daniel Deronda. These are extremely long novels, but I am confident that I can complete the reading in one semester. I will also read critical essays on these novels and reviews of them that appeared during Eliot's lifetime.

Please let me know if you would be willing to sponsor this project.

Regards,

Alyssa Avelin

versions.label: Koala 08-05
versions.imageText:
English 202: The Sonnet

The sonnet entered English literature in the early sixteenth century, adapted from the Italian form pioneered by Petrarch, and has inspired experimentation ever since. Poets writing in English have created endless variations on the basic formula of fourteen lines of rhymed verse in iambic pentameter.

From the Renaissance to the modern era, poets have used the sonnet form to explore romantic, existential, and political themes in ways both serious and satiric. Because the sonnet is governed by strict formal rules, it is sometimes used to playfully illuminate the tension between constraint and creative freedom.

Readings will include sonnets by Sir Philip Sidney, William Shakespeare, John Donne, William Wordsworth, Claude McKay, Gwendolyn Brooks, Edna St. Vincent Millay, Cathy Park Hong, and Jericho Brown. Students will experiment with writing their own sonnets and will read them aloud in class.

A final ten-page term paper will be due on May 15.
versions.imageTextZh:
英语202：十四行诗
十四行诗在十六世纪早期进入英国文学，它改编自彼特拉克开创的意大利形式，并从那时起一直激发着人们进行实验。
用英语写作的诗人基于十四行五步抑扬格押韵诗的基本模式创造了无尽的变体。
从文艺复兴到现代，诗人们运用十四行诗的形式，以严肃和讽刺的方式探索浪漫、存在和政治主题。
由于十四行诗受到严格的形式规则的制约，它有时被用来幽默地阐明束缚与创作自由之间的张力。
阅读材料将包括菲利普·西德尼爵士、威廉·莎士比亚、约翰·多恩、威廉·华兹华斯、克劳德·麦凯、格温多林·布鲁克斯、埃德娜·圣文森特·米莱、凯茜·朴·洪和杰里科·布朗的十四行诗。
学生们将尝试写自己的十四行诗，并在课堂上大声朗读。
长达十页的期末论文将于5月15日截止。

Library Quiet Zone

Welcome to the Library Quiet Zone!

This area is specifically designated for quiet reading and study to ensure a peaceful environment for all patrons. Please adhere to the following guidelines:

1. Noise Levels: Please keep noise to a minimum. This includes refraining from loud conversations and phone calls.
2. Electronic Devices: Ensure that all electronic devices, such as phones and laptops, are set to silent mode. The volume on headphones must be kept low.
3. Conversations: If you need to have a conversation, please conduct it quietly or proceed to another area of the library.
4. Music and Media: Listening to music or watching videos without headphones is not allowed. Please keep the volume of headphones at a level that only you can hear.
5. Respect for Others: Be mindful of those around you who are studying or reading. Your cooperation helps maintain a serene environment for everyone.

versions.label: Koala 09-05
versions.articleTitle: Stay Healthy During Cold And Flu Season
versions.imageText:
Stay Healthy During Cold And Flu Season

Cases of flu have been climbing this winter, and the Campus Health Services office is advising all students, faculty, and staff to take precautions.

Campus Health Services offers free flu vaccinations and recommends that everyone except those with vaccine allergies come to get the quick and effective shot.

In addition, measures like handwashing can make a big difference in reducing your exposure to the flu virus. And of course, if you feel sick, avoid close contact with others to keep from spreading your illness.

Flu symptoms include fever, aches, sore throat, and fatigue. While these symptoms are also typical of the common cold, the flu tends to come on quite rapidly and symptoms can be severe.

Students experiencing these symptoms should see one of the Health Services doctors as soon as possible. In some cases, antiviral medication may be prescribed.
versions.imageTextZh:
感冒与流感季节保持健康
今年冬天流感病例不断攀升，校园健康服务中心建议所有学生、教职员工采取预防措施。
校园健康服务中心提供免费流感疫苗接种，并建议除对疫苗过敏的人员外，所有人均应前来接种这种快速且有效的疫苗。
此外，勤洗手等措施在减少流感病毒暴露方面也能起到很大作用。
当然，如果你感到不适，请避免与他人密切接触，以防传播疾病。
流感症状包括发烧、疼痛、喉咙痛和疲劳。
虽然这些症状也是普通感冒的典型特征，但流感往往发作迅速，且症状可能非常严重。
出现这些症状的学生应尽快咨询健康服务中心的医生。
在某些情况下，医生可能会开抗病毒药物。

versions.label: Koala 04-27
versions.imageText:
Kyoto Exchange Semester

Emma Lee

I can't believe I'm already halfway through my exchange semester in Japan. Time really flies when you have a busy class schedule! Last weekend, after wrapping up midterms, I finally headed out of Osaka. My destination? Kyoto.

Day 1: Temples and Shrines: I started my day at the Fushimi Inari Shrine, famous for its thousands of torii gates. It was a steep climb, but the view was absolutely worth it. Later, I visited the Kinkaku-ji, the Golden Pavilion, which was stunning, with its gold-leaf-covered exterior reflecting on the tranquil pond.

Day 2: Exploring Gion Kobu, one of Kyoto's historic districts, was fascinating. I walked through the narrow streets lined with traditional wooden teahouses. The atmosphere was magical, and it seemed as if I was stepping back in time.

I'll share more about Kyoto. Stay tuned for updates!
versions.imageTextZh:
京都交换学期
艾玛·李
真不敢相信，我在日本的交换学期已经过半了。
课表排得很满的时候，时间过得真快！
上个周末，在结束了期中考试后，我终于走出了大阪。
我的目的地？
京都。
第一天：寺庙和神社：我的一天从伏见稻荷大社开始，这里以成千上万的鸟居而闻名。
这是一段陡峭的攀登，但风景绝对值得。
之后，我参观了金阁寺（Golden Pavilion），它令人惊艳，表面覆盖的金箔倒映在宁静的池塘中。
第二天：探索京都历史街区之一的祇园甲部，令人着迷。
我漫步在狭窄的街道上，两旁是传统的木制茶馆。
这里的气氛很奇妙，感觉就像时光倒流了一样。
我还会分享更多关于京都的事情。
敬请期待更新！

IN TUNE WITH WELL-BEING:

A Full-Spectrum Wellness Journey

Join us for In Tune With Well-Being: A Full-Spectrum Wellness Journey, a dynamic event designed to enhance your physical, mental, and emotional well-being, on Thursday, November 16 from 10 A.M. to 4 P.M. at the Rowancourt University Community Center.

Discover a range of activities including a restorative yoga session led by renowned instructor Lucas Gyeon, a mindfulness meditation workshop guided by Dr. Elara Mondragón, and a nutrition discussion featuring holistic health coach Jamie Khoa.

Engage in a thought-provoking panel discussion on the intersection of mental health and academic success with faculty members from the Department of Psychology.

Connect with health-conscious peers at our afternoon social, featuring live acoustic music by local students.

Admission is free for all students and faculty. Preregistration is encouraged, but walk-ins are welcome! RSVP at wellness.rowancourt.edu.

For more information, contact the Wellness Council at wellness@rowancourt.edu or visit our website.

versions.articleTitle: CHEN'S PRODUCTION MAKES A BUZZ THAT "ECHOES" ACROSS CAMPUS
versions.imageText:
CHEN'S PRODUCTION MAKES A BUZZ THAT "ECHOES" ACROSS CAMPUS

In a bold departure from typical campus productions, student director Sofia Chen staged The Enigma of Echoes, a play that blurs the line between reality and perception. The play is set in a research lab where scientists wrestle with questions about consciousness, even as their experiment begins to threaten their very sanity. The production's strength lies in its minimalist staging. Sparse lighting and carefully chosen sound effects draw the audience's focus to the performers' psychological intensity rather than to elaborate scenery. While some viewers may find the philosophical themes challenging, the play's final moments left this reviewer deeply moved and quite reflective. Standout performances included Liam Patel's portrayal of Dr. Everett, a scientist caught between self-discovery and self-doubt. The ensemble cast also conveyed the vulnerability of their roles with impressive nuance, especially for student actors, offering a layered look at human frailty.
versions.imageTextZh:
陈的戏剧作品在校园内引起了“回声”般的轰动
学生导演索菲娅·陈大胆突破了典型的校园戏剧制作，将《回声之谜》搬上了舞台，这部剧模糊了现实与感知之间的界限。
该剧以一个研究实验室为背景，科学家们在那里苦苦思索有关意识的问题，甚至当他们的实验开始威胁到他们自身理智时也是如此。
这部作品的优势在于其极简主义的舞台布置。
稀疏的灯光和精心挑选的音效将观众的注意力吸引到了表演者强烈的心理表现上，而不是复杂的布景上。
虽然一些观众可能会觉得这些哲学主题具有挑战性，但这出戏的最后时刻让本评论员深受感动并陷入深思。
出色的表演包括利亚姆·帕特尔饰演的埃弗里特博士，一个夹在自我发现和自我怀疑之间的科学家。
全体演员也以令人印象深刻的细腻程度传达了他们角色的脆弱性，对于学生演员来说更是如此，展现了对人类脆弱性的多层次审视。

Local Farmer's Market

Sofia Baker

Every Saturday, our local farmer's market is the place to be! Fresh fruits, veggies, homemade goodies, and unique crafts await you. The Thompson family's organic produce is a must-try, known for its quality and cordial service. Their stall is always bustling with customers eager to buy fresh, pesticide-free vegetables from the welcoming staff.

Don't miss the bakery stall-get there early for the best bread and pastries, including gluten-free and vegan options. The smell of freshly baked goods fills the air, and these treats sell out fast!

In addition to food, the market sells handmade crafts like jewelry, pottery, and textiles. These unique items make perfect gifts and support local artisans. Plus, enjoy live music while you shop. Talented local musicians help create a vibrant atmosphere, and the community spirit makes it a delightful experience for all. See you there!
versions.imageTextZh:
当地农贸市场
索菲亚·贝克
每周六，我们当地的农贸市场都是个好去处！
新鲜的水果、蔬菜、自制美食和独特的手工艺品在这里等着你。
汤普森家的有机农产品绝对不容错过，它以高品质和热情的服务而闻名。
他们的摊位总是熙熙攘攘，挤满了顾客，大家都渴望从热情的员工那里购买新鲜、无农药的蔬菜。
不要错过烘焙摊位——早点去买最好的面包和糕点，包括无麸质和纯素的选择。
新鲜烘焙食品的香气弥漫在空气中，而且这些美味很快就会卖光！
除了食物，市场上还出售珠宝、陶器和纺织品等手工工艺品。
这些独特的物品是绝佳的礼物，同时也能支持当地的工匠。
此外，你还可以在购物时欣赏现场音乐。
才华横溢的当地音乐家营造了充满活力的氛围，而社区精神让每个人都能享受到愉快的体验。

Rethinking Documentary Panel Jordan Miles
November 3 at 5:37 PM We're seeking two additional members for our panel at the 2026 Media Studies Conference hosted by Poplar College. Please email jmiles@poplar.edu if interested. Panel title: Rethinking Documentary--Collaboration and Authorship Panel description: This panel explores ways to involve participants in documentary production beyond traditional observation. Historically, filmmakers have controlled the narrative, leaving little room for those on camera to shape their own stories. We'll discuss methods for working directly with participants to ensure accuracy and trust, providing strategies for scholars and practitioners interested in building stronger partnerships with the communities they document. Academic Rationale: Recent scholarship emphasizes participatory and community-driven practices as a response to long-standing concerns about representation and authorship. By examining strategies for collaboration, this panel contributes to debates about ethics and methodological innovation in documentary research and production. Confirmed Participants: Jordan Miles (Moderator), Poplar College; Taylor Chen, Summit University.

重新思考纪录片研讨小组 乔丹·迈尔斯
11月3日下午5:37 我们正在为由白杨学院举办的2026年媒体研究会议上的研讨小组寻找两名额外成员。 如果感兴趣，请发送电子邮件至jmiles@poplar.edu。 小组名称： 重新思考纪录片——合作与作者身份 小组简介： 本小组探讨在传统观察之外，让参与者介入纪录片制作的方法。 从历史上看，电影制作人一直控制着叙事，几乎没有给镜头前的人留下塑造自己故事的空间。 我们将讨论直接与参与者合作以确保准确性和信任的方法，为有意在与其记录的社区建立更紧密合作关系的学者和从业者提供策略。 学术理据： 近期的学术研究强调参与式和社区驱动的实践，以此作为对有关代表权和作者身份长期担忧的回应。 通过探讨合作策略，本小组致力于为有关纪录片研究与制作中伦理和方法论创新的辩论做出贡献。 已确认参会者： 乔丹·迈尔斯（主持人），白杨学院；泰勒·陈，顶峰大学。

versions.label: Koala 08-09
versions.imageText:
Literature Review Extension

Subject: Literature review

Dear Professor Allen,

I am writing to request an extension for the literature review due this Friday. I have been out with a bad cold for the past three days and have a doctor's note confirming my condition.

Only yesterday was I finally able to get out of bed, and I started working diligently to finish the assignment. Fortunately, I was able to compile the list of sources before I got sick, but I will need additional time to finalize the analysis section.

Would it be possible to submit the review by next Wednesday instead? I understand the importance of deadlines and will ensure the paper meets all formatting and citation requirements.

Thank you for considering my situation.

Best regards,

Liam Carter
versions.imageTextZh:
文献综述延期
主题：文献综述
尊敬的艾伦教授：
我写信是想申请推迟原定于本周五交的文献综述。
过去三天我因患重感冒未能上课，并有医生证明证实我的病情。
直到昨天我才终于能下床，并开始努力完成作业。
幸运的是，我在生病前已经整理好了文献来源列表，但我需要额外的时间来完成分析部分。
请问能否改为下周三提交综述？
我明白截止日期的重要性，并会确保论文符合所有格式和引用要求。
感谢您体谅我的情况。
诚挚的问候，
利亚姆·卡特

versions.imageText:
Film Studies at Adler Auditorium

Read an article.

ON MARCH 18, FILM STUDIES MAJORS PRESENTED THEIR WORK AT ADLER AUDITORIUM.

Four short films created by students were screened, and each filmmaker answered questions from audience members. The films were striking in their variety. The program began with a whimsical animated film, *Insides*, depicting the internal organs of a human body interacting with one another like family members. Filmmaker Kat Morgan said the idea came to her while she was taking Human Anatomy 101.

Next up was Alan Hinds' sober black-and-white documentary *On My Feet*, chronicling his brother's unsuccessful attempt to become a champion marathon runner.

The third film in the series was Margot Bridges' comedy *The Date*, about a mismatched couple on a movie date.

And lastly, the audience saw *The Friend*, Priti Patel's tender depiction of a toddler's relationship with a protective dog.

All four films were technically accomplished, engaging, and reflective of each filmmaker's distinctive, individual talents.
versions.imageTextZh:
阿德勒大礼堂的电影研究
阅读一篇文章。
3月18日，电影研究专业的学生在阿德勒大礼堂展示了他们的作品。
现场放映了由学生创作的四部短片，每位电影制作者都回答了观众的提问。
这些电影的多样性令人印象深刻。
节目以一部异想天开的动画电影《内部》（*Insides*）开场，该片描绘了人体器官像家庭成员一样相互互动的场景。
电影制作者凯特·摩根说，这个创意是在她上“人体解剖学101”课程时产生的。
接下来的作品是艾伦·海因茨那部严肃的黑白纪录片《在路上》（*On My Feet*），记录了他哥哥试图成为马拉松冠军的失败尝试。
系列中的第三部电影是玛格特·布里奇斯的喜剧片《约会》（*The Date*），讲述了一对不般配的男女在看电影约会时发生的故事。
最后，观众观看了普里蒂·帕特尔的《朋友》（*The Friend*），这部电影温情地描绘了一个幼儿与一只具有保护欲的狗之间的关系。
这四部电影在技术上都非常纯熟，引人入胜，反映了每位电影制作者独特且个性化的才华。

Global Beats: International Culture Night

Read a flyer.

Join us for a celebration of music, dance, and culture from across the  
globe!

Global Beats: International Culture Night brings student groups and  
campus performers together at Hartley Auditorium for live sets,  
pop-up dance lessons (salsa, bhangra, K-pop), a parade of flags, and a  
showcase of traditional dress.

Explore cultural booths, sample global snacks, and drop into an  
interactive drumming circle. Feel free to wear clothing that represents  
your heritage and get ready to move!

All are welcome: students, staff, families, and neighbors.

Doors open at 7:00 P.M. with a DJ warm-up; performances begin soon  
after. A sign-up list for community spotlight slots will be posted near  
the entrance.

Entry is free, and there is limited front-row seating, so plan to  
arrive early to secure a spot near the heart of the action. Celebrate  
diversity, discover new rhythms, and leave with a few new steps in your  
repertoire. Let's make the campus dance!
